VULNDB_CPE.description: CPE 2.3 string to query (e.g. cpe:2.3:a:apache:http_server:2.4.54). At least one of VULNDB_CPE or VULNDB_VENDOR is required.

VULNDB_VENDOR.description: Vendor name or numeric VulnDB vendor id (e.g. 'apache' or '15'). Resolved via /vendors lookup when a name is supplied. At least one of VULNDB_CPE or VULNDB_VENDOR is required.

VULNDB_PRODUCT.description: Optional product name narrowing the vendor query (forwarded as product_name to /vendors/{id}/vulnerabilities). Ignored when VULNDB_VENDOR is not set.

VULNDB_LIMIT.description: Maximum vulnerabilities to retrieve per query. Default 100; pagination stops once this many entries have been collected.

name: vulndb
title: VulnDB
description: VulnDB / Flashpoint vulnerability database importer. Queries /api/v1/vulnerabilities (by CPE) and /api/v1/vendors/{id}/vulnerabilities (by vendor, optionally narrowed by product); emits one synthetic Faraday host per query target with severity bucketed from CVSS (0=info, <4=low, <7=medium, <9=high, >=9=critical). Auth is HMAC-SHA1 — VULNDB_KEY identifies the consumer, VULNDB_SECRET signs each request (X-Vulndb-Key / X-Vulndb-Hmac / X-Vulndb-Timestamp / X-Vulndb-Nonce headers).
